25.t: 7. EXPLANATION OF TEST AND DATA DISPLAY

By operating the switch unit, periodically perform the tests and data check. When installing the machine initially or collecting cash, or when the machine does not function correctly, perform checking in accordance with the explanations given in this section. The following shows tests and modes that should be utilized as applicable.

IMPORTANT! CAUTIONS TO BE HEEDED WHEN USING THE TEST MODE: In the case where plural machines are linked for communication play, if even one seat enters the test mode, all of the linked seats will enter the test mode. Therefore, if anyone of the linked machines is in play, use care so as not to use the test mode. The contents of the setting changes made will made will not be effective unless the test mode is finished in the test mode. When the setting is changed, be sureto “EXIT” in the menu mode. Do not press the TEST BUTTION during network check at the time of turning the power on or exiting from the test mode. If anyone of the linked machines uses the test mode during network check, all other Seats will continue network checking. Cause all of the Seats to reenter the test mode and then have all of the Seats exit from the test mode simultaneously.
